name: ZBS_CUST_COMPTTR_PURCHS
description: This table is to store information of Purchases from Competitors by customers.  The information will be used by Competitor Product Landscape and other products.

columns.name: PURCHASE_ID
columns.description: Identifier for the entry.  One entry per purchase from competitor.

columns.name: USER_KEY
columns.description: A public surrogate that is visible to end users.  This indicates the difference sources when import existing data from another source like SEBL.

columns.name: CUSTOMER_PARTY_ID
columns.description: FK reference to the TCA HZ_PARTIES.PARTY_ID for the customer.

columns.name: COMPETITOR_PARTY_ID
columns.description: FK reference to the TCA HZ_PARTIES.PARTY_ID for the competitor.

columns.name: PRODUCT_GROUP_ID
columns.description: Product category Identifier (Solution ID).  This is the FK to QSC_PROD_GROUPS_B.

columns.name: REVN_ENTERED_AMT
columns.description: Monetary amount the customer spent on this purchase.

columns.name: REVN_CURRENCY_CODE
columns.description: The currency code for the REVN_ENTERED_AMT.  FK to FND_CURRENCIES.

columns.name: DESCRIPTION
columns.description: Freely style text of description for this purchase.

columns.name: PRIMARY_FLG
columns.description: Valid values are 'Y' and "N'.  Indicate if the competitor is primary competitor.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: USER_LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Disconnected Mobile: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row. This value is different from LAST_UPDATE_DATE if the update originally happened in a different database (i.e. a different mobile database or the server).
